usage: The word 鐘 (zung1) is used to refer to a clock or timepiece.
It can be used on its own or combined with other words to specify types of clocks, such as 鬧鐘 (alarm clock).
鐘 is countable and can be used with measure words like 個 (go3) for general objects.
You can use 鐘 in time expressions, for example, 三點鍾 (3 o'clock).
It frequently appears in daily conversation related to telling time or household furniture.
